title: PollElementProps
description: The props of a poll: an optional title, a question and two options, each with an id that stays the same when its label is edited, so its count survives the edit, and a light or dark theme. All text is plain, on one line, without control characters. Clients render the options as buttons; a visitor's vote is posted to the Delivery API and the poll then shows each option's percentage. A tale holds at most one poll. The `view` picks how the poll is drawn (sticker, embed, this-or-that, grid or inline); each option's optional `color` is used only by this-or-that and grid, and is content data (the app's own category colour), not part of the theme.

title.description: A short heading above the question; none when left out.

options.description: The two answers, in the order they show.

id.description: The option's id, unique in the poll and kept when its label changes: votes are counted by it.

label.description: The answer as visitors read it: its accessible name.

color.description: Optional colour of the option as #rrggbb; used only by the this-or-that and grid views, as content data (not theme).

theme.description: `light` draws dark text on a light card; `dark` light text on a dark card.

view.description: How the poll is drawn: sticker, a small card on the tale; embed, a card that holds its own results; this-or-that, two large halves to pick between; grid, the options as tiles; inline, the options as plain rows in the flow of the page. Left out, sticker.
